entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2612830229101544704: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.8865 +/- 0.0146 mas (same row, RUWE 1.06): 112.53 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 75.462, 5.831 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.696 +/- 0.023 solar radii from Howard et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-62 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract). Mass 0.67 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Howard et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-62 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract). Temperature 4455 +/- 70 K from Howard et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-62 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,455 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffddba. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,455 K and log g 4.58 (u1 0.775, u2 0.020): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
